Check state-wise updates By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 16, 2026, 06:31:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis School holiday tomorrow news: On November 17, 2026, schools in Bihar and Jharkhand will be closed for Chhath Puja celebrations. Most other states are expected to operate normally, maintaining their regular schedules. Parents and students should check local notifications from schools regarding any changes to reopening dates. Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Rajasthan, and West Bengal schools are likely to remain open.
 Agencies School Holiday Tomorrow, November 17, 2026: Are schools closed for Chhath Puja? Check state-wise updates
 Schools in Bihar and Jharkhand will remain closed on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, on account of Chhath Puja celebrations. Schools in most other states are likely to follow their regular schedules, as no statewide holiday has been confirmed for the date. However, school holidays may vary by district and institution. Parents and students are advised to check official notifications issued by their respective state education departments, district administrations and schools before heading out.
 Bihar School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Bihar will remain closed on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, as per the announced holiday schedule. Students and parents should check with their respective schools for details about reopening dates and any changes to the academic calendar.
 Jharkhand School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Jharkhand are also expected to remain closed on November 17, 2026, on account of a regional holiday. Parents and students should refer to official state and school notifications for confirmation. 
 Delhi School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Delhi are expected to remain open on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the date. Government and private schools are likely to follow their regular schedules.
 Uttar Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Uttar Pradesh are expected to remain open on November 17, 2026, as no statewide closure has been confirmed. Students in different districts should check with their school authorities for any local holiday announcements.
 Live Events
 Rajasthan School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Rajasthan are expected to operate as usual on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, with no statewide school holiday announced for the date.
 West Bengal School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across West Bengal are expected to remain open on November 17, 2026, unless individual institutions announce a local holiday.
 Himachal Pradesh School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Himachal Pradesh are expected to follow their regular schedules on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, as no statewide school holiday has been confirmed.
 Odisha School Holiday Tomorrow 
Schools across Odisha, including Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Rourkela, Sambalpur and Balasore, are expected to remain open on November 17, 2026, as no statewide school closure has been announced.
